page.content:
Gnome bard of Scanlan's Hand and the party's filthy inspiration.

How Scanlan Shorthalt connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Scanlan Shorthalt is the bard of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Sam Riegel — Sam Riegel plays Scanlan Shorthalt.

What is Scanlan Shorthalt?

Scanlan Shorthalt is Sam Riegel's Campaign 1 bard, the gnome whose songs, mansion, and later departure-and-return sit beside Pike and Kaylie in Vox Machina's heart.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina and Sam Riegel.
